_doc: Policy-rate step functions for the carry_quiet_week test (docs/specs/carry_quiet_week_spec.md). Each list is [effective_date, annual_percent]; a rate holds from its date until the next entry. Fetched 2026-10-29 from the official sources below; values outside 2003-2014 omitted.

GBP.source: Bank of England, Bank Rate history: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/Bank-Rate.asp

AUD.source: Reserve Bank of Australia, cash rate target: https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/cash-rate/

JPY.source: Bank of Japan: uncollateralized overnight call rate target. Quantitative easing 2001-03 to 2006-03 (rate effectively zero) and the 2006-07 / 2007-02 changes: https://www.boj.or.jp/en/research/brp/ron_2007/ron0707c.htm ; 2008-10-31 and 2008-12-19: https://www.boj.or.jp/en/research/brp/ron_2009/ron0908d.htm ; 2010 'around 0 to 0.1 percent': https://www.boj.or.jp/en/about/education/oshiete/seisaku/b42.htm . Held at 0.1 after 2008-12-19 (the top of the 2010 range): for a long-GBP/short-JPY position a higher JPY rate means less carry, so this is the conservative choice.
